approval_ref: The user requested Trunk Tools-style questions answered from existing project files.
notes: Reproduce a model answer that recombines date components from cited project text into a date the source never states.
Ground each explicit full date in an answer or source finding against that item's own exact quotations.
Treat ISO and English month-name formats as formatting equivalents, while slash dates retain their written order because locale is ambiguous.
Make no provider request, dependency, migration, date arithmetic, chronology inference or authority inference.
title: Ground project-answer dates in citations
objective: Reject explicit dates absent from their own citations without interpreting ambiguous slash formats or adding another service.
